body:
This lightweight Modrinth modpack packs just over 40 carefully selected mods designed to dramatically boost your performance by a guaranteed 100+ FPS. It masterfully optimizes your game's engine, delivering buttery-smooth gameplay and enhanced, crisp graphics at the exact same time.

CleanCraft is a lightweight, performance focused modpack designed to make the game look, feel, and run better without horrible lag.

The modpack features enhanced visuals through resource packs such as Fresh Animations, with improved ambient sounds and immersive details that make the world feel nicer. It also includes  quality of life mods like Xaero’s Minimap and Xaero’s World Map for easier exploration.

To ensure smooth gameplay, CleanCraft uses powerful optimization mods including Sodium and several additional performance mods, allowing Minecraft to run faster and more smoother while still looking great!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

# Using Vanilla
- 150 FPS
- Many Stutters
- Not Fun

# Using CleanCraft
- 500 FPS
- No Stutters
- Fun 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Specs 

- Ryzen 5 5500

- 3060 ti

- 16 ddr4 ram

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

None of the mods, resource packs, included in this modpack are created by me. Full credit belongs to their developers. This modpack is simply a carefully selected collection of mods designed to provide a smoother, and more optimized Minecraft experience.
